summary: A glass showcase card for a single marketing feature, with icon, title, and description.
purpose: Highlight one product feature in a bento grid on marketing surfaces. Reach for it instead of a raw Surface when the block is a titled, icon-led feature pitch.

anatomy.description: The glass container with an accent top-border glow.
Optional accent-colored icon at the top.
The feature name, rendered as a heading.
One or two sentences of supporting copy.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading icon, tinted with the accent.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color, mapped to the status tokens (urgent, analysis, success).

props.name: delay
props.description: Scroll-in animation delay in seconds, for staggering a grid.

whenToUse: Presenting a product feature in a marketing bento grid.
A titled block with an icon and a short pitch.

whenNotToUse.scenario: Showing an interactive user problem or case
A plain container with no feature framing

do: Keep the title to a few words and the description to one or two sentences.
Stagger a grid with the delay prop for a calm cascade.
dont: Put interactive controls inside; it is a display card.
Hardcode the accent color; use the accent prop.

content.voice: Satirical, confident marketing copy; the UnmessMe wink.
rules: Title is a short noun phrase.
Description is one to two sentences.

keyboard: No interactive elements; nothing to tab to inside the card.
aria: Title renders as an h3 heading.
A decorative icon should not carry meaning alone.
accessibility.contrast: Title and description hold at least 4.5:1 against the glass surface.
accessibility.focus: No focus state; the card is non-interactive.

examples.title: Feature block
examples.code: <FeatureCard title="Panic to Plan" description="Turn AHHHHHH into 3 actionable steps." icon={<Bolt />} accent="terracotta" delay={0.3} />

related.whenToChoose: ProblemCard is an interactive case on the app surface; FeatureCard is a static marketing highlight.
Surface is the raw glass container; FeatureCard adds the feature layout on top of it.
